items.title: Wilson & Curtis leave Scotland squad to join U-21s
items.summary: Forwards James Wilson and Findlay Curtis leave the Scotland Nations League squad in order to play for the Under-21 team against Azerbaijan on Wednesday.

items.title: McPake's 'colourful' journey from club-less to Scotland call-up in three years
items.summary: Three years ago, Josh McPake was without a club. Twenty months ago, he was in the shop window but "no-one wanted him". This week, he's involved in his first Scotland camp. Here, BBC Sport Scotland charts the fall and rise of the winger who's got everyone in the country talking.

items.title: 'Better performance, better result for Hearts'
items.summary: Sportscene analyst James McFadden assesses Hearts' week after a defeat by Falkirk and draw at Kilmarnock.

items.title: Disallowed goal 'a big mistake' - Vrancken
items.summary: Hearts head coach Wouter Vrancken reacts to a 1-1 Scottish Premiership draw with Kilmarnock.

items.title: What are the key questions in Saturday's Scottish Premiership?
items.summary: What are the key questions on Saturday in the final Scottish Premiership games before the international break?

items.title: Rangers-Aberdeen semi on 31 October, Edinburgh derby on 1 November
items.summary: Rangers and Aberdeen's Premier Sports Cup semi-final will take place on 31 October at 17:30 BST, with the Edinburgh derby last-four tie scheduled for 1 November at 15:00.

items.title: Does derby semi add 'more spice' or simply 'nice for fans'?
items.summary: While Hibernian head coach David Gray is relishing a "very special" Premier Sports Cup semi-final against Heart of Midlothian, counterpart Wouter Vrancken is keeping cool about the prospect.

items.title: Man charged over assault at Celtic and Hearts title decider
items.summary: The game on 16 May saw scores of fans run onto the pitch in injury time, after Celtic scored a third goal.

items.title: Rangers v Aberdeen & Edinburgh derby in League Cup semis
items.summary: Rangers have been drawn against Aberdeen in the semi-finals of the Premier Sports Cup, while rivals Heart of Midlothian and Hibernian will face off in the other tie at Hampden Park.

items.title: Hearts 'have to be above emotions' as big favourites
items.summary: Hearts head coach Wouter Vrancken insists there can be no excuses as his side prepare to face Stenhousemuir at Ochilview on Friday with a place in the Premier Sports Cup semi-finals at stake.

items.title: Kerjota scores 96th-minute winner for Hearts against Dundee
items.summary: Claudio Braga's penalty and Sabah Kerjota's brilliant low drive earn Hearts a dramatic Scottish Premiership victory over Dundee, extending their unbeaten run in all competitions to eight matches.

items.title: Four wins in a row, but can it only get better for Hearts?
items.summary: Hearts move up to second place in the Premiership as new head coach Wouter Vrancken gets to grips with a much-changed squad at Tynecastle.

items.title: Best moments of McPake's scintillating derby display
items.summary: Josh McPake shone in Hearts' 3-1 Scottish Premiership win over Edinburgh rivals Hibernian.
